_comment: Measured ROS 2 whole-network-pinning baseline. One record per (cell, assignment). Medians are over 3 reps and the spread is quoted with them; no single-rep number appears as a result. `makespan` is the wall clock from t0 to the last instance of any network completing -- the same quantity XPU-RT's runtime prints as `[summary] wall=`. `np` is the makespan over NON-PERIODIC networks only, which is the objective the sweep10 solver comparison actually ranks on. Window feasibility (`missed_*`) is reported separately and is never folded into the makespan.
